name: Evaluated Applications
holder: Dongyang Stephen Chen, trading as Evaluated Applications
pitch: High-performance .NET libraries for data, models and games.
lede: Most of them share one idea: computing with holographic vectors, on a runtime that tunes itself to your hardware. The tools run entirely in your browser, with nothing uploaded.
description: High-performance .NET libraries: an embeddable SQL database, a transformer engine, pathfinding and a pipeline runtime, plus tools that run in your browser.
